bio-luminescent reef guide, post-collapse, rendered as cel-shaded concept art moodboard, warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows, draped silk

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'bio-luminescent reef guide, post-collapse, rendered as cel-shaded'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated. Lighting reference: split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
